052/**
053 * SQLAccount
054 *
055 * @author creatorfromhell
056 * @since 0.1.2.0
057 */
058public class SQLAccount implements Datable<Account> {
059
060  /**
061   * The class that is represented by the O parameter.
062   *
063   * @return The class that represents the parameter.
064   */
065  @Override
066  public Class<? extends Account> clazz() {
067
068    return Account.class;
069  }
070
071  /**
072   * USed to purge the objects of this datable.
073   *
074   * @param connector The storage connector to use for this transaction.
075   */
076  @Override
077  public void purge(final StorageConnector<?> connector) {
078
079    if(connector instanceof final SQLConnector sql && sql.dialect() instanceof final TNEDialect tne) {
080      sql.executeUpdate(tne.accountPurge(
081                                DataConfig.yaml().getInt("Data.Purge.Accounts.Days")
082                                        ),
083                        new Object[]{});
084    }
085  }
086
087  /**
088   * Used to store this object.
089   *
090   * @param connector The storage connector to use for this transaction.
091   * @param account   The object to be stored.
092   */
093  @Override
094  public void store(final StorageConnector<?> connector, @NotNull final Account account, @Nullable final String identifier) {
095
096    if(connector instanceof final SQLConnector sql && sql.dialect() instanceof final TNEDialect tne) {
097
098      PluginCore.log().debug("Saving Account with ID: " + identifier + " Name: " + account.getName(), DebugLevel.STANDARD);
099
100      resolveUsernameConflict(sql, tne, account);
101
102      //store the basic account information(accounts table)
103      final int test = sql.executeUpdate(tne.saveAccount(),
104                                         new Object[]{
105                                                 account.getIdentifier().toString(),
106                                                 account.getName(),
107                                                 (account.type()),
108                                                 new java.sql.Timestamp(account.getCreationDate()),
109                                                 account.getPin(),
110                                                 account.getStatus().identifier(),
111                                                 account.getName(),
112                                                 account.getPin(),
113                                                 account.getStatus().identifier(),
114                                                 });
115
116      PluginCore.log().debug("Account Insert Executed correctly: " + test + " - " + identifier, DebugLevel.DETAILED);
117
118      if(!accountPersisted(sql, tne, account.getIdentifier().toString())) {
119        PluginCore.log().warning("Skipping dependent account table saves for " + account.getIdentifier() +
120                              " (" + account.getName() + "): account row was not persisted. " +
121                              "This usually means a unique username conflict with a different uid.");
122        return;
123      }
124
125      if(account instanceof final PlayerAccount playerAccount) {
126
127        //Player account storage.(players_accounts table)
128        final int test2 = sql.executeUpdate(tne.savePlayer(),
129                                            new Object[]{
130                                                    account.getIdentifier().toString(),
131                                                    new java.sql.Timestamp(playerAccount.getLastOnline()),
132                                                    new java.sql.Timestamp(playerAccount.getLastOnline())
133                                            });
134        PluginCore.log().debug("Player Account Insert Executed correctly: " + test2 + " - " + identifier, DebugLevel.DETAILED);
135
136      }
137
138      if(account instanceof final SharedAccount shared) {
139
140        //Non-player accounts.(non_players_accounts table)
141        final String owner = (shared.getOwner() == null)? account.getIdentifier().toString() :
142                             shared.getOwner().toString();
143        sql.executeUpdate(tne.saveNonPlayer(),
144                          new Object[]{
145                                  account.getIdentifier().toString(),
146                                  owner,
147                                  owner
148                          });
149
150        //Account members(account_members table)
151        for(final Member member : shared.getMembers().values()) {
152          for(final Map.Entry<String, Boolean> entry : member.getPermissions().entrySet()) {
153            sql.executeUpdate(tne.saveMembers(),
154                              new Object[]{
155                                      member.getId().toString(),
156                                      account.getIdentifier().toString(),
157                                      entry.getKey(),
158                                      entry.getValue(),
159                                      entry.getValue()
160                              }
161                             );
162          }
163        }
164      }
165
166      TNECore.instance().storage().storeAll(account.getIdentifier().toString());
167      account.clearDirty();
168
169      final AccountSaveCallback callback = new AccountSaveCallback(account);
170      PluginCore.callbacks().call(callback);
171    }
172  }
173
174
175  private void resolveUsernameConflict(@NotNull final SQLConnector sql,
176                                       @NotNull final TNEDialect dialect,
177                                       @NotNull final Account account) {
178
179    final String accountUid = account.getIdentifier().toString();
180
181    try(final ResultSet conflict = sql.executeQuery(dialect.loadAccountByUsername(), new Object[]{ account.getName() })) {
182
183      if(!conflict.next()) return;
184
185      final String conflictingUid = conflict.getString("uid");
186      if(accountUid.equalsIgnoreCase(conflictingUid)) return;
187
188      final String expiredName = findAvailableExpiredUsername(sql, dialect, account.getName(), conflictingUid);
189
190      final int renamed = sql.executeUpdate(dialect.expireAccountUsername(),
191                                            new Object[]{ expiredName, conflictingUid, account.getName() });
192
193      PluginCore.log().warning("Detected username collision for '" + account.getName() + "': reassigned uid " +
194                            conflictingUid + " to expired username '" + expiredName + "' before saving uid " +
195                            accountUid + " (rows updated: " + renamed + ").");
196
197    } catch(final SQLException e) {
198      PluginCore.log().debug("Unable to resolve username conflict for " + accountUid + ": " + e.getMessage(),
199                             DebugLevel.STANDARD);
200    }
201  }
202
203  private @NotNull String findAvailableExpiredUsername(@NotNull final SQLConnector sql,
204                                                       @NotNull final TNEDialect dialect,
205                                                       @NotNull final String username,
206                                                       @NotNull final String conflictingUid) throws SQLException {
207
208    String candidate = buildExpiredUsername(username, conflictingUid, null);
209
210    if(!usernameExists(sql, dialect, candidate)) return candidate;
211
212    for(int attempt = 1; attempt <= 9999; attempt++) {
213      candidate = buildExpiredUsername(username, conflictingUid, attempt);
214
215      if(!usernameExists(sql, dialect, candidate)) {
216        return candidate;
217      }
218    }
219
220    return buildExpiredUsername(username, conflictingUid, System.currentTimeMillis() % 10000);
221  }
222
223  private boolean usernameExists(@NotNull final SQLConnector sql,
224                                 @NotNull final TNEDialect dialect,
225                                 @NotNull final String username) throws SQLException {
226
227    try(final ResultSet result = sql.executeQuery(dialect.loadAccountByUsername(), new Object[]{ username })) {
228      return result.next();
229    }
230  }
231
232  private @NotNull String buildExpiredUsername(@NotNull final String username,
233                                               @NotNull final String conflictingUid,
234                                               @Nullable final Number attemptSuffix) {
235
236    final String suffix = conflictingUid.replace("-", "").substring(0, 8);
237    final String expireTag = (attemptSuffix == null)? "-expired-" + suffix :
238                             "-exp-" + suffix + "-" + attemptSuffix;
239    final int maxBaseLength = min(50 - expireTag.length(), username.length());
240
241    return username.substring(0, maxBaseLength) + expireTag;
242  }
243
244  private boolean accountPersisted(@NotNull final SQLConnector sql,
245                                   @NotNull final TNEDialect dialect,
246                                   @NotNull final String identifier) {
247
248    try(final ResultSet result = sql.executeQuery(dialect.loadAccount(), new Object[]{ identifier })) {
249      return result.next();
250
251    } catch(final SQLException e) {
252      PluginCore.log().debug("Unable to verify persisted account row for " + identifier + ": " + e.getMessage(),
253                             DebugLevel.STANDARD);
254      return false;
255    }
256  }
257
258  /**
259   * Used to store all objects of this type.
260   *
261   * @param connector The storage connector to use for this transaction.
262   */
263  @Override
264  public void storeAll(final StorageConnector<?> connector, @Nullable final String identifier) {
265
266    if(connector instanceof SQLConnector) {
267      for(final Account account : TNECore.eco().account().getAccounts().values()) {
268        if(account.isDirty()) {
269          store(connector, account, account.getIdentifier().toString());
270        }
271      }
272    }
273  }
274
275  @Override
276  public void delete(final StorageConnector<?> connector, @NotNull final String identifier) {
277
278    PluginCore.log().debug("Deleting Account with ID: " + identifier, DebugLevel.STANDARD);
279
280    if(connector instanceof final SQLConnector sql && sql.dialect() instanceof final TNEDialect tne) {
281
282      sql.executeUpdate(tne.deleteAccount(), new Object[]{ identifier });
283    }
284
285
286  }
287
288  /**
289   * Used to load this object.
290   *
291   * @param connector  The storage connector to use for this transaction.
292   * @param identifier The identifier used to identify the object to load.
293   *
294   * @return The object to load.
295   */
296  @Override
297  public Optional<Account> load(final StorageConnector<?> connector, @NotNull final String identifier) {
298
299    if(connector instanceof final SQLConnector sql && sql.dialect() instanceof final TNEDialect tne) {
300      final Account account = loadBasicAccount(sql, tne, identifier);
301      if(account != null) {
302        loadPlayerInfo(sql, tne, identifier, account);
303        loadSharedInfo(sql, tne, identifier, account);
304        finishAccountLoad(identifier, account);
305      }
306      return Optional.ofNullable(account);
307    }
308    return Optional.empty();
309  }
310
311  private Account loadBasicAccount(final SQLConnector sql, final TNEDialect tne, final String identifier) {
312
313    try(final ResultSet result = sql.executeQuery(tne.loadAccount(), new Object[]{ identifier })) {
314      if(!result.next()) {
315        return null;
316      }
317      final String type = result.getString("account_type");
318      final AccountAPIResponse response = TNECore.eco().account().createAccount(
319              identifier, result.getString("username"),
320              !(type.equalsIgnoreCase("player") || type.equalsIgnoreCase("bedrock")), true);
321      if(!response.getResponse().success() || response.getAccount().isEmpty()) {
322        return null;
323      }
324
325      final Account account = response.getAccount().get();
326      account.setStatus(TNECore.eco().account().findStatus(result.getString("status")));
327      account.setCreationDate(result.getTimestamp("created").getTime());
328      account.setPin(result.getString("pin"));
329      return account;
330    } catch(final SQLException e) {
331      e.printStackTrace();
332      return null;
333    }
334  }
335
336  private void loadPlayerInfo(final SQLConnector sql, final TNEDialect tne, final String identifier,
337                              final Account account) {
338
339    if(!(account instanceof final PlayerAccount playerAccount)) {
340      return;
341    }
342    try(final ResultSet result = sql.executeQuery(tne.loadPlayer(), new Object[]{ identifier })) {
343      if(result.next()) {
344        playerAccount.setLastOnline(result.getTimestamp("last_online").getTime());
345      }
346    } catch(final SQLException e) {
347      e.printStackTrace();
348    }
349  }
350
351  private void loadSharedInfo(final SQLConnector sql, final TNEDialect tne, final String identifier,
352                              final Account account) {
353
354    if(!(account instanceof final SharedAccount shared)) {
355      return;
356    }
357    try(final ResultSet result = sql.executeQuery(tne.loadNonPlayer(), new Object[]{ identifier })) {
358      if(result.next()) {
359        shared.setOwner(UUID.fromString(result.getString("owner")));
360      }
361    } catch(final SQLException e) {
362      e.printStackTrace();
363    }
364
365    try(final ResultSet result = sql.executeQuery(tne.loadMembers(), new Object[]{ identifier })) {
366      while(result.next()) {
367        shared.addPermission(UUID.fromString(result.getString("uid")), result.getString("perm"),
368                             result.getBoolean("perm_value"));
369      }
370    } catch(final SQLException e) {
371      e.printStackTrace();
372    }
373  }
374
375  private void finishAccountLoad(final String identifier, final Account account) {
376
377    final Collection<HoldingsEntry> holdings = TNECore.instance().storage().loadAll(HoldingsEntry.class, identifier);
378    for(final HoldingsEntry entry : holdings) {
379      account.getWallet().setHoldings(entry);
380    }
381    account.clearDirty();
382    PluginCore.callbacks().call(new AccountLoadCallback(account));
383  }
384
385  /**
386   * Used to load all objects of this type.
387   *
388   * @param connector The storage connector to use for this transaction.
389   *
390   * @return A collection containing the objects loaded.
391   */
392  @Override
393  public Collection<Account> loadAll(final StorageConnector<?> connector, @Nullable final String identifier) {
394
395    final Collection<Account> accounts = new ArrayList<>(); // is this required? Not entirely sure it is - seems maybe a waste
396
397    if(connector instanceof final SQLConnector sql && sql.dialect() instanceof final TNEDialect tne) {
398
399      final List<String> ids = new ArrayList<>();
400      try(final ResultSet result = sql.executeQuery(tne.loadAccounts(),
401                                                    new Object[]{})) {
402        while(result.next()) {
403          ids.add(result.getString("uid"));
404        }
405
406      } catch(final SQLException e) {
407        e.printStackTrace();
408      }
409
410      for(final String id : ids) {
411
412        final Optional<Account> loaded = load(connector, id);
413        if(loaded.isPresent()) {
414          accounts.add(loaded.get());
415          TNECore.eco().account().uuidProvider().store(new UUIDPair(loaded.get().getIdentifier(), loaded.get().getName()));
416        }
417      }
418    }
419    return accounts;
420  }
421}
